# YamlDotNet

Vendored dependency for the Telemetry snapshot exporter (`Assets/Runtime/Telemetry/`).

- **Version:** 18.1.0 (netstandard2.0 build)
- **Source:** https://www.nuget.org/packages/YamlDotNet/18.1.0
- **License:** MIT
- **Why:** compact, human-readable runtime UI snapshot export; no UPM package needed.

Do not add `.cs` sources from this package; only the DLL belongs here so it compiles
into `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`.
